hard_gates.name: sensitivity-first-fail-closed-execution
hard_gates.evidence: The V12 workflow had no provider execution runner.

hard_gates.name: atomic-checkpoint-and-binding-safe-resume
hard_gates.evidence: The V12 workflow could build a packet but could not checkpoint or resume provider work.

hard_gates.name: live-identity-pricing-and-output-preflight
hard_gates.evidence: The V12 preflight did not check credential presence, exact live metadata, clean worktree, or output exclusivity.

hard_gates.name: paid-execution-remains-unauthorized
hard_gates.evidence: The control made no provider call and granted no authorization.

hard_gates.name: sensitivity-first-fail-closed-execution
hard_gates.evidence: Regression simulation stops before all 12 bulk batches when reviewer sensitivity fails.

hard_gates.name: atomic-checkpoint-and-binding-safe-resume
hard_gates.evidence: Every simulated call checkpoints atomically and resume rejects instrument, packet, revision, runner, or model drift.

hard_gates.name: live-identity-pricing-and-output-preflight
hard_gates.evidence: Live no-call preflight matched exact model metadata and pricing, found the credential present, worktree clean, and output unused.

hard_gates.name: paid-execution-remains-unauthorized
hard_gates.evidence: The three authorization locks remain closed and no provider inference call occurred.

hard_gates.name: private-and-heldout-data-remain-closed
hard_gates.evidence: Only synthetic-public fixtures were read; private and held-out data stayed closed.

decision.rationale: The finite runner and all fail-closed paths passed network-free verification, while provider execution remains separately authorization-gated.
limitations: The simulation does not establish independent-review quality.
The 120-case draft remains unfrozen and unopened for candidate evaluation.
No evidence-sufficiency implementation or product release candidate is selected.
The exact provider metadata must be refreshed again if it becomes older than 24 hours before execution.
